source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 4 exercise solved (PDF 89-92), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Work, Energy and Power) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai; short sawalon ke chhote jawab, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke poore model jawab, aur numericals step by step (Given, formula, values, jawab) hal kiye gaye hain. Jahan kitab mein ghalti hai wahan "Kitab ki ghalti" box hai, aur mushkil jagah "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
4.1 A 1 kg mass has potential energy of 1 joule relative to the ground when it is at a height of:
(1 kg mass ki ground ke lehaz se potential energy 1 joule hai jab woh kitni unchai par ho?)
blocks.explanation: P.E. = mgh, to h = P.E./(mg) = 1 J ÷ (1 kg × 9.8 m s⁻²) = 0.102 m.

blocks.prompt:
4.2 An iron sphere whose mass is 30 kg has the same diameter as an aluminium sphere whose mass is 10.5 kg. The spheres are simultaneously dropped from a cliff. When they are 10 m from the ground, they have identical:
(30 kg ke iron sphere ka diameter 10.5 kg ke aluminium sphere jitna hai. Dono ek saath cliff se giraye jate hain. Ground se 10 m upar dono ki kya cheez barabar hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Dono ek hi acceleration g = 9.8 m s⁻² se free fall karte hain (is liye har unchai par speed bhi ek jaisi). Momentum mv, P.E. mgh aur K.E. ½mv² mass par depend karte hain, is liye mukhtalif hain.

blocks.prompt:
4.3 A body at rest may have:
(Aaram (rest) mein para jism ke paas kya ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rest mein v = 0 hai, is liye speed, velocity aur momentum zero hain, lekin jism ke paas apni position (jaise mgh) ya dabi hui halat ki wajah se potential energy ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.4 The height above the ground of a child on a swing varies from 0.5 m of his lowest point to 1.5 m at his highest point. The maximum speed of the child is approximately:
(Jhoole par bachche ki unchai sab se neeche 0.5 m aur sab se upar 1.5 m hai. Bachche ki zyada se zyada speed taqreeban kitni hai?)

options.text: Bachche ki mass par depend karti hai

blocks.explanation: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida: mgh = ½mv², h = 1.5 − 0.5 = 1.0 m. v = √(2gh) = √(2 × 9.8 × 1.0) = 4.4 m s⁻¹ (mass cancel ho jati hai).

blocks.prompt:
4.5 When a ball is thrown vertically upward and then falls back to the ground, which force can be considered conservative in this scenario?
(Ball seedhi upar phenki jaye aur wapas ground par gire to is mein kaun si force conservative hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity ka kaam raste par depend nahi karta aur aane jaane ke poore safar mein zero hai, is liye gravity conservative hai. Air resistance aur friction non-conservative hain (4.3).

blocks.prompt:
4.6 According to work-energy principle in linear motion, the work done on body is equal to:
(Linear motion mein work-energy principle ke mutabiq jism par kiya gaya kaam kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Work-energy theorem: net force ka jism par kiya gaya kaam us ki kinetic energy ki tabdeeli ke barabar hai, W = ½mv_f² − ½mv_i² (4.7).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chothi option par label dobara (b) chhapa hai: "(b) sum of K.E. and P.E.". Yeh option (d) hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.7 Power of a lamp is 6 W. How much energy does a lamp give out in 2 min?
(Lamp ki power 6 W hai. 2 minute mein lamp kitni energy deta hai?)

4.8 A dry battery can deliver 3000 J of energy to a 2 W small electric motor before the battery is exhausted. For how many minutes does the battery run?
(Dry battery khatam hone se pehle 2 W ki chhoti motor ko 3000 J energy de sakti hai. Battery kitne minute chalegi?)

4.9 The kinetic energy acquired by a mass m after travelling a fixed distance from rest under the action of a constant force is directly proportional to:
(Constant force ke zere asar rest se ek muqarrar faasla tay karne ke baad mass m jo kinetic energy hasil karti hai woh kis ke seedha mutanasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Work-energy theorem se hasil K.E. = kaam = Fd. Muqarrar force F aur faasle d ke liye yeh har mass ke liye ek jaisi hai, yani m se azad.

blocks.prompt:
4.10 A body moves a distance of 10 m along a straight line under the action of 5 N force. If the work done is 25 J, the angle which the force makes with the direction of motion of the body is:
(5 N force ke zere asar jism seedhi line mein 10 m chalta hai. Agar kaam 25 J ho to force motion ki direction se kitna angle banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: W = Fd cos θ: 25 = 5 × 10 × cos θ, cos θ = 0.5, θ = 60°.

blocks.prompt:
4.1 Why is electrical power required at all when the elevator is descending? Why should be there be a limit on the number of passengers in this case?
Lift neeche aa rahi ho to bhi bijli ki power kyun chahiye? Is surat mein musafiron ki tadaad ki had kyun honi chahiye?
blocks.explanation:
Neeche aane ko qaboo mein rakhne ke liye power chahiye: motor (brakes ke saath) gravity ke khilaf kaam karti hai taa ke lift mehfooz, ek jaisi speed se aaye aur har floor par ruke; counterweight uthane aur friction par qaboo ke liye bhi.
Jitna zyada bojh, utni zyada force usay thamne aur rokne ke liye chahiye; cable aur motor mehdood force bardasht karte hain, is liye musafiron ki had zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.2. A body is being raised to a height H from surface of Earth. What is the sign of work done by both? justify.
Ek jism ko Earth ki satah se unchai H tak uthaya ja raha hai. Dono (uthane wali force aur gravity) ke kaam ka sign kya hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Uthane wali force ka kaam positive hai, kyunke force aur displacement dono upar hain (θ = 0°): W = +mgH.
Gravity ka kaam negative hai, kyunke mg neeche aur displacement upar hai (θ = 180°): W = −mgH.

blocks.prompt:
4.3 A body falls towards the Earth in air. Will its total mechanical energy be conserved during fall? Justify.
Jism hawa mein Earth ki taraf girta hai. Kya girte waqt us ki kul mechanical energy conserve rahegi? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Nahi. Hawa ki mukhalifat (non-conservative force) motion ke khilaf lagti hai aur P.E. ka kuch hissa us ke khilaf kaam mein (heat ban kar) kharch hota hai.
P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf kaam (mgh = ½mv² + fh), is liye kul mechanical energy kam ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.4 Calculate power of a crane in kilowatt which lifts a mass of 1000 kg to a height of 100 m in 20 second.
Crane 1000 kg mass ko 20 second mein 100 m unchai tak uthata hai. Us ki power kilowatt mein nikalein.

4.5 A trolley of mass 1500 kg carrying sand bags of 500 kg is moving uniformly with a speed of 40 km h⁻¹ on a frictionless track. After some time, sand starts leaking out of whole sand bags on the road at a rate of 0.05 kg s⁻¹. What is the speed of the trolley after entire sand bags are empty?
1500 kg ki trolley 500 kg ke rait ke thaile le kar frictionless track par 40 km h⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Rait 0.05 kg s⁻¹ ki raftar se road par girne lagti hai. Saare thaile khaali hone ke baad trolley ki speed kya hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Speed 40 km h⁻¹ hi rahegi.
Rait trolley jitni hi aage ki velocity ke saath girti hai, is liye apna momentum saath le jati hai aur trolley par koi horizontal force nahi lagati; frictionless track par koi bairooni force nahi, is liye trolley ki velocity nahi badalti.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rait trolley se "peeche ki taraf dhakel" kar nahi nikal rahi, balkay trolley jitni speed se hi neeche girti hai. Is liye trolley ko na aage dhakka milta hai na peeche; mass kam hone se bhi speed nahi badalti (koi force nahi to velocity wahi).

blocks.prompt:
4.6 When will you say that a force is conservative? Also give an example.
Aap kab kahenge ke force conservative hai? Misal bhi dein.
blocks.explanation:
Force conservative hai agar do points ke darmiyan jism ko le jane mein us ka kaam raste par depend na kare, ya band raste (closed path) par us ka kaam zero ho.
Misal: gravitational force (aur electrostatic aur spring ki elastic force).

blocks.prompt:
4.7 Give absolute and gravitational units of work on M.K.S & C.G.S systems.
M.K.S aur C.G.S systems mein kaam ke absolute aur gravitational units batayein.
blocks.explanation:
M.K.S: absolute unit = joule (1 J = 1 N × 1 m); gravitational unit = kilogram-weight metre (1 kg-wt m = 9.8 J).
C.G.S: absolute unit = erg (1 erg = 1 dyne × 1 cm = 10⁻⁷ J); gravitational unit = gram-weight centimetre (1 g-wt cm = 980 erg).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Gravitational unit mein force ko wazan (weight) mein naapte hain: 1 kg-wt = 9.8 N aur 1 g-wt = 980 dyne. Yeh units is chapter mein nahi likhe; yeh pichhli classes se hain.

blocks.prompt:
4.8 A body dropped from a height of H reaches the ground with a speed of 1.2√(gH). Calculate work done by air friction.
Unchai H se giraya gaya jism 1.2√(gH) speed se ground par pohanchta hai. Hawa ki friction ka kaam nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Ground par K.E. = ½m(1.2√(gH))² = ½m × 1.44gH = 0.72 mgH
P.E. ka nuqsan = mgH
Hawa ki friction ka kaam = K.E. − mgH = 0.72 mgH − mgH = −0.28 mgH
(yani 0.28 mgH energy hawa ki friction ke khilaf kharch hui).

blocks.prompt:
4.9 A bicycle has a K.E. of 150 J. What K.E. would the bicycle have if it had?
(i) Same mass but has speed double?
(ii) Three times mass and was moving with one half of the speed?
Cycle ki K.E. 150 J hai. Agar (i) mass wahi aur speed double ho, (ii) mass teen guna aur speed aadhi ho, to K.E. kitni hogi?

4.10 What will be the effect on K.E. of the body having mass m, moving with velocity v when its momentum becomes double? Justify.
Mass m aur velocity v wale jism ka momentum double ho jaye to us ki K.E. par kya asar hoga? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
K.E. chaar guna ho jati hai.
K.E. = ½mv² = p²/2m. Agar p, 2p ho jaye (mass wahi), to K.E. = (2p)²/2m = 4 × p²/2m.

blocks.prompt:
4.11 Does the international space-station have gravitation P.E. or/and Kinetic energy? Explain.
Kya International Space Station ke paas gravitational P.E. aur/ya kinetic energy hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono hain.
Yeh apne orbit mein bohat tez (taqreeban 7.7 km s⁻¹) chalta hai, is liye K.E. = ½mv² hai.
Yeh Earth ke gravitational field mein centre se r faasle par hai, is liye gravitational P.E. U = −GMm/r hai (negative, lekin Earth ki satah se zyada).

blocks.prompt:
4.1 When will you say that a force is conservative? Give two conditions.
Aap kab kahenge ke force conservative hai? Do sharait (conditions) batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Force conservative kehlati hai agar:
1. Ek point se doosre tak jism le jane mein us ka kaam raste par depend na kare (sirf shuru aur aakhri position par depend kare). Misal: A se B tak kisi bhi raste se gravity ka kaam −mgh hai.
2. Band raste (closed path) par us ka kaam zero ho (jaise ACBA par W = −mgh + mgh = 0).
Misalein: gravitational force, electrostatic force aur spring ki elastic force. Friction aur air resistance non-conservative hain.

blocks.prompt:
4.2 A light and heavy body have same linear momentum, which one has greater K.E.?
Halka aur bhaari jism dono ka linear momentum barabar hai. Kis ki K.E. zyada hai?
blocks.explanation:
Halke jism ki K.E. zyada hai.
K.E. = ½mv² = p²/2m.
Momentum p barabar ho to K.E. ∝ 1/m, is liye kam mass wale jism ki K.E. zyada hai (barabar momentum ke liye usay kahin zyada speed se chalna parta hai).

blocks.prompt:
4.3 A motorcycle is running with constant speed on a horizontal track. Is any work being done on the motorcycle, if no net force is acting on it?
Motorcycle horizontal track par constant speed se chal rahi hai. Agar us par koi net force nahi to kya us par koi kaam ho raha hai?
blocks.explanation:
Us par koi net kaam nahi ho raha.
Work-energy theorem se net kaam = K.E. ki tabdeeli. Speed constant hai, is liye ΔK.E. = 0 aur net kaam zero hai (F_net = 0, to W = F_net d = 0).
Albatta engine ki force positive kaam karti hai aur friction/hawa ki mukhalifat utna hi negative kaam karti hai; dono cancel ho jate hain. Horizontal track par gravity aur normal force koi kaam nahi karti (motion par perpendicular hain).

blocks.prompt:
4.4 A force acts on a ball moving with 14 m s⁻¹ speed and brings its speed to 6 m s⁻¹. Has the force done positive or negative work? Explain your answer.
14 m s⁻¹ se chalti ball par force lagti hai aur speed 6 m s⁻¹ kar deti hai. Force ne positive kaam kiya ya negative? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Force ne negative kaam kiya.
Work-energy theorem se W = ½mv_f² − ½mv_i² = ½m(6² − 14²) = ½m(36 − 196) = −80m J (m, kg mein).
Ball ki K.E. kam hui, is liye W negative hai; force motion ke ulat lag rahi hai (θ > 90°).

blocks.prompt:
4.5 A slow moving truck can have more kinetic energy than a fast moving car. How is this possible?
Ahista chalne wale truck ki kinetic energy tez chalti car se zyada kaise ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation:
K.E. = ½mv² mass aur speed dono par depend karti hai.
Truck ki mass car ke muqable mein bohat zyada hai. Kam speed ke bawajood us ki bari mass ½mv² ko zyada kar sakti hai.
Misal: truck m = 10 000 kg, v = 10 m s⁻¹: K.E. = 5 × 10⁵ J; car m = 1000 kg, v = 20 m s⁻¹: K.E. = 2 × 10⁵ J. Ahista truck ki K.E. zyada hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.6 Why work done against friction is non-conservative in nature? Explain briefly.
Friction ke khilaf kiya gaya kaam non-conservative kyun hai? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic friction hamesha motion ke ulat lagti hai, is liye f × (raste ki lambai) ke barabar negative kaam karti hai.
1. Is liye kaam raste par depend karta hai: unhi do points ke darmiyan lamba rasta zyada kaam mangta hai.
2. Band raste par (wapas shuru par aa kar) friction ke khilaf kaam zero nahi hota; aane jaane dono mein jama hota hai.
3. Yeh energy heat ban jati hai aur mechanical energy ki shakal mein wapas nahi milti.
Is liye friction non-conservative force hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.7 Does wind contain kinetic energy? Explain.
Kya hawa (wind) mein kinetic energy hoti hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Hawa chalti hui hawa (air) hai; hawa ki mass hai aur wind ki velocity hai, is liye us mein K.E. = ½mv² hai.
Yeh energy kaam kar sakti hai: hawa windmills aur wind turbines ghumati hai (bijli banane ke liye), baadbani kashtiyan chalati hai, aur tez aandhi darakht ukhaar deti aur imaraton ko nuqsan pohanchati hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.1 Define K.E. Derive an expression for the same.
K.E. ki tareef karein aur us ka formula derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic energy: jism ke paas us ki motion ki wajah se jo energy hoti hai use kinetic energy kehte hain.

Derivation:
Mass m ki car speed v se chal rahi hai. Engine band karne par bhi woh rukne se pehle faasla d tay karti hai; chalte hue woh friction f ke khilaf kaam karti hai. Is liye us ki K.E. = friction ke khilaf kaam = fd.
Friction negative acceleration paida karti hai: f = −ma, ya a = −f/m.
Motion ki teesri equation se: 2aS = v_f² − v_i²
jahan v_i = v, v_f = 0, S = d, a = −f/m:
2 × (−f/m) × d = 0 − v²
fd = ½mv²
Chunkay fd jism ki kinetic energy ke barabar hai:
K.E. = ½mv²   (Eq. 4.9)
Is ka unit kaam wala hai, joule (J). K.E. scalar quantity hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.2 How work is done by a:
(i) constant force (ii) variable force?
Kaam kaise hota hai: (i) constant force se (ii) variable (badalti) force se?
blocks.explanation:
(i) Constant force ka kaam:
Jab constant force F jism ko apni direction mein d displace kare: W = Fd.
Agar F displacement se angle θ banaye to sirf d ke saath wala hissa F cos θ kaam karta hai:
W = (F cos θ) d = Fd cos θ, ya W = F⃗ · d⃗ (scalar). Unit: joule (1 J = 1 N m).
θ < 90°: positive kaam; θ = 90°: koi kaam nahi; θ > 90°: negative kaam.
Force-displacement graph par constant force horizontal line hai aur kaam us ke neeche rectangle ka area (F × d) hai.

(ii) Variable force ka kaam:
P se Q tak raste ko n chhote displacements Δd₁, Δd₂, …, Δdₙ mein baant dete hain, itne chhote ke har ek mein force F₁, F₂, …, Fₙ taqreeban constant rahe.
ΔW₁ = F₁ cos θ₁ Δd₁, ΔW₂ = F₂ cos θ₂ Δd₂, …
W_total = Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ   (Eq. 4.4)
F cos θ banam d graph par har term ek patli rectangle ka area hai. Δd → 0 lene se:
W_total = lim(Δd→0) Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ   (Eq. 4.5)
Yani variable force ka P aur Q ke darmiyan kaam F cos θ banam d curve ke neeche ke area ke barabar hai. Misal: Earth se door jate rocket par gravity ke khilaf kaam, ya spring ko kheenchna.

blocks.prompt:
4.3 Define conservative field. Show that gravitational field is conservative in nature.
Conservative field ki tareef karein. Dikhayein ke gravitational field conservative hai.
blocks.explanation:
Conservative field: woh field jis mein jism ko ek point se doosre tak le jane ka kaam raste par depend na kare, ya band raste par kaam zero ho. (Earth ke gird woh jagah jahan us ki gravitational force lagti hai gravitational field hai.)

Gravitational field ke liye saboot:
Mass m ka jism constant speed se A se B le jaya jata hai; B, A se unchai h par hai. Gravitational force us ka wazan mg hai jo neeche lagta hai.
Rasta 1 (ADB): AD (horizontal) par kaam = 0, kyunke mg displacement par perpendicular hai; DB (upar) par kaam = −mgh.
W_ADB = 0 + (−mgh) = −mgh
Rasta 2 (ACB): AC (upar) par kaam = −mgh; CB (horizontal) par kaam = 0.
W_ACB = −mgh + 0 = −mgh
Rasta 3 (koi bhi curved rasta AB): usay chhote horizontal aur vertical steps mein todein. Horizontal steps par kaam nahi; vertical steps par:
W_AB = −mg(Δy₁ + Δy₂ + … + Δyₙ) = −mgh, kyunke Δy₁ + Δy₂ + … + Δyₙ = h.
Har raste par kaam −mgh hai, yani raste se azad.
Band raste par bhi, jaise ACBA: W = −mgh (A se B) + mgh (B se wapas A) = 0.
Is liye gravitational field conservative field hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.4 What is meant by absolute P.E.? Derive an expression for absolute P.E.
Absolute P.E. se kya muraad hai? Is ka formula derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Absolute potential energy: kisi position par jism ki absolute gravitational P.E. woh kaam hai jo gravitational force jism ko us position se infinity (la-mehdood faasle) tak le jane mein karti hai, jahan gravity ki force zero ho jati hai.

Derivation:
mgh sirf Earth ki satah ke qareeb sahi hai; bare faasle par force F = GMm/r² badalti hai. Is liye point 1 (Earth ke centre se r₁) se point N tak faasle ko Δr lambai ke chhote steps mein baant-te hain, jin mein force taqreeban constant rahe.
Pehle step (r₁ se r₂) ke beech ka faasla r = (r₁ + r₂)/2 = r₁ + Δr/2
r² = r₁² + r₁Δr + (Δr/2)² ≈ r₁² + r₁Δr ((Δr)² chhor kar)
= r₁² + r₁(r₂ − r₁) = r₁r₂
Is step mein force: F = GMm/(r₁r₂)
Gravity ka kaam (force displacement ke ulat, θ = 180°):
W₁→₂ = F Δr cos 180° = −GMm (r₂ − r₁)/(r₁r₂) = −GMm (1/r₁ − 1/r₂)
Isi tarah: W₂→₃ = −GMm (1/r₂ − 1/r₃), …, W_(N−1)→N = −GMm (1/r_(N−1) − 1/r_N)
Kul kaam: W_total = −GMm [(1/r₁ − 1/r₂) + (1/r₂ − 1/r₃) + … + (1/r_(N−1) − 1/r_N)]
W_total = −GMm (1/r₁ − 1/r_N)
Agar point N infinity par ho to r_N = ∞ aur 1/r_N = 0:
W_total = −GMm/r₁
Yehi kaam absolute P.E. hai: U = −GMm/r
Earth ki satah par (r = R): U_g = −GMm/R   (Eq. 4.13)
Negative sign batata hai ke gravitational field kashish wala (attractive) hai; GMm/R woh energy hai jo jism ko Earth ke gravitational field se bahar nikalne ke liye chahiye. r barhne se U kam negative, yani P.E. zyada hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.5 State and explain work-energy theorem in a resistive medium.
Resistive medium (mukhalifat wale mahaul) mein work-energy theorem bayan karein aur samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Work-energy theorem: kisi cheez ki kinetic energy mein tabdeeli us par net force ke kiye gaye kaam ke barabar hai.
Saboot: force F mass m ke jism par lagti hai jo v_i se chal raha hai, faasla d tak, aur velocity v_f kar deti hai.
2ad = v_f² − v_i², to a = (v_f² − v_i²)/2d; aur a = F/m.
F/m = (v_f² − v_i²)/2d
Fd = ½mv_f² − ½mv_i²   (Eq. 4.18)
W = (K.E.)_f − (K.E.)_i

Resistive medium mein (friction ya hawa ki mukhalifat f ke saath):
Kaam ya energy ka kuch hissa mukhalif force ke khilaf kharch hota hai, baqi K.E. badalta hai.
• Lagai gayi force F aur friction f, faasla d: (F − f)d = ½mv_f² − ½mv_i², yani F ka kaam = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf kaam (fd).
• Mass m ka jism unchai h se hawa mein girta hai: P.E. ka kuch hissa friction ke khilaf (fh) kharch hota hai, baqi P.E. K.E. banti hai:
mgh − fh = ½mv², ya mgh = ½mv² + fh   (Eq. 4.21)
P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf kaam
Ulat, upar jate jism ke liye: K.E. ka nuqsan = P.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf kaam.
Friction ke khilaf kaam heat ban jata hai, is liye resistive medium mein mechanical energy conserve nahi rehti.

blocks.prompt:
4.6 Define escape velocity. Show that an expression for escape velocity can be expressed as √(2Rg), where R and g denote radius of the Earth and acceleration due to gravity, respectively. Also find its numerical value.
Escape velocity ki tareef karein. Dikhayein ke escape velocity √(2Rg) hai, jahan R Earth ka radius aur g gravity ki acceleration hai. Is ki numerical value bhi nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Escape velocity: woh ibtidai velocity jis se koi cheez Earth ke gravitational field se bahar nikal jaye escape velocity kehlati hai.

Derivation:
Jism tab nikal jata hai jab us ki ibtidai K.E. usay infinity tak le jaye.
Ibtidai K.E. = ½mv_esc²
Satah (U = −GMm/R) se infinity (U = 0) tak uthane ka kaam:
P.E. mein izafa = 0 − (−GMm/R) = GMm/R
Jism tab nikalta hai jab ibtidai K.E. = P.E. ka izafa:
½mv_esc² = GMm/R
v_esc = √(2GM/R)   (Eq. 4.14)
Chunkay g = GM/R², is liye GM/R = gR:
v_esc = √(2gR)   (Eq. 4.15)

Numerical value (g = 9.8 m s⁻², R = 6.4 × 10⁶ m):
v_esc = √(2 × 9.8 m s⁻² × 6.4 × 10⁶ m)
= √(1.254 × 10⁸ m² s⁻²)
= 1.12 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹ ≈ 11.2 km s⁻¹ (taqreeban 11 km s⁻¹)
Yeh jism ki mass par depend nahi karti.

blocks.prompt:
4.1 A machine gun fires 6 bullets per minute with a velocity of 700 m s⁻¹. If each bullet has a mass of 40 g, then find power developed by the gun? (Ans: 9800 watt)
Machine gun 700 m s⁻¹ ki velocity se har minute 6 goliyan chalati hai. Har goli ki mass 40 g hai. Gun ki power nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: n = 6 goliyan per minute; t = 1 min = 60 s; v = 700 m s⁻¹; m = 40 g = 0.04 kg
Required: power P = ?
Ek goli ki K.E. = ½mv² = ½ × 0.04 kg × (700 m s⁻¹)² = 9800 J
Ek minute mein di gayi energy = 6 × 9800 J = 58 800 J
P = W/t = 58 800 J ÷ 60 s
P = 980 W

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (Ans: 9800 watt) likhti hai. 9800 J ek goli ki kinetic energy hai, power nahi. 6 goliyan per minute 60 s mein 6 × 9800 J = 58 800 J deti hain, is liye P = 980 W. (9800 W ke liye 60 goliyan per minute chahiye.)

blocks.prompt:
4.2 A family uses 10 kW of power. Direct solar energy is incident on horizontal surface at an average rate of 300 per square metre. If 75% of this energy can be converted into useful electrical energy, how large area is needed to supply 10 kW? (Ans: 44.44 m²)
Ek ghar 10 kW power istemal karta hai. Horizontal satah par sooraj ki energy average 300 W per square metre aati hai. Agar is ka 75% kaam ki bijli ban sake to 10 kW ke liye kitna area chahiye?
blocks.explanation:
Given: zaroori power P = 10 kW = 10 000 W; solar power = 300 W m⁻²; efficiency = 75%
Required: area A = ?
Har square metre se kaam ki power = 300 W m⁻² ka 75% = 0.75 × 300 = 225 W m⁻²
A = zaroori power ÷ har m² ki kaam ki power
A = 10 000 W ÷ 225 W m⁻²
A = 44.44 m²

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein "300 per square metre" chhapa hai, unit (W) reh gaya hai; matlab 300 W m⁻², yani har square metre par har second 300 J sooraj ki energy aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.3 If mass of the Earth is 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg and mass of Sun is 1.99 × 10³⁰ kg. The sun is 160 million km away from the Earth. Find the value of gravitational P.E. of the Earth. (Ans: ≈ −4.97 × 10³³ J)
Earth ki mass 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg aur Sooraj ki mass 1.99 × 10³⁰ kg hai. Sooraj Earth se 160 million km door hai. Earth ki gravitational P.E. nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: m (Earth) = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg; M (Sooraj) = 1.99 × 10³⁰ kg
r = 160 million km = 160 × 10⁶ × 10³ m = 1.6 × 10¹¹ m; G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²
Required: gravitational P.E. U = ?
U = −GMm/r
U = −(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 1.99 × 10³⁰ × 6.0 × 10²⁴) ÷ 1.6 × 10¹¹ J
U = −(79.6 × 10⁴³) ÷ (1.6 × 10¹¹) J
U ≈ −4.97 × 10³³ J

blocks.prompt:
4.4 Water in a bucket tied with rope is whirled around in a vertical circle radius 0.5 m. Calculate minimum velocity at the lowest point so that water does not spill from it. (Ans: 4.94 m s⁻¹)
Rassi se bandhi baalti ka pani 0.5 m radius ke vertical circle mein ghumaya jata hai. Sab se neeche wale point par kam se kam velocity kitni ho ke pani na gire?
blocks.explanation:
Given: r = 0.5 m; g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Required: sab se neeche wale point par kam se kam velocity v_b = ?
Top par pani tab nahi girta jab us ka wazan bas centripetal force de de:
mg = mv_t²/r, to v_t² = gr
Neeche se top tak pani 2r upar jata hai; energy ke conservation se:
½mv_b² = ½mv_t² + mg(2r)
v_b² = gr + 4gr = 5gr
v_b = √(5gr) = √(5 × 9.8 m s⁻² × 0.5 m)
v_b = √(24.5 m² s⁻²)
v_b = 4.95 m s⁻¹ ≈ 4.94 m s⁻¹ (jaisa kitab mein hai)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pani sab se zyada khatre mein top par hota hai. Wahan kam se kam speed √(gr) chahiye. Neeche se top tak jate hue pani ki kuch K.E. P.E. ban jati hai, is liye neeche speed zyada, √(5gr), honi chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
4.5 A 75 watt fan is used for 8 hours daily for 30 days. Find:
(i) energy consumed in electrical units
(ii) electricity bill of fan if one unit cost is Rs. 22.5? (Ans: (i) 18 units (ii) Rs. 405)
75 watt ka pankha 30 din tak rozana 8 ghante chalta hai. (i) bijli ke units mein kharch energy, (ii) ek unit Rs. 22.5 ho to pankhe ka bill nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: P = 75 W = 0.075 kW; t = 8 h × 30 = 240 h; qeemat = Rs. 22.5 per unit
(i) Energy = Pt = 0.075 kW × 240 h = 18 kW h
1 unit = 1 kW h, to energy = 18 units
(ii) Bill = 18 units × Rs. 22.5
Bill = Rs. 405

blocks.prompt:
4.6 If an object of mass 2 kg is thrown up from ground reaches a height of 5 m and falls back to the Earth (neglecting air resistance), calculate:
(i) work done by gravity when object reaches at 5 m height.
(ii) work done by gravity when the object comes back to the Earth.
(iii) total work done by gravity in upward and downward motion. Also mention physical significance of the result.
[Ans: (i) −98 J (ii) +98 J (iii) 0 J significant gravity does not transfer any energy to object]
2 kg ki cheez ground se upar phenki jati hai, 5 m tak jati hai aur wapas girti hai (hawa ki mukhalifat nahi). (i) 5 m tak jate hue gravity ka kaam, (ii) wapas aate hue gravity ka kaam, (iii) kul kaam aur us ki ahmiyat batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 2 kg; h = 5 m; g = 9.8 m s⁻²
(i) Upar jate hue: mg neeche, displacement upar (θ = 180°)
W₁ = mgh cos 180° = −2 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² × 5 m = −98 J
(ii) Neeche aate hue: mg aur displacement dono neeche (θ = 0°)
W₂ = mgh cos 0° = +98 J
(iii) Kul kaam = W₁ + W₂ = −98 J + 98 J = 0 J
Ahmiyat: band raste (upar aur wapas) par gravity ka kaam zero hai, is liye gravity conservative force hai. Gravity cheez ko koi net energy nahi deti: upar jate hue jo K.E. li, neeche aate hue wapas kar di, aur cheez usi speed se wapas aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.7 An electrical motor of one horse power is used to run a water pump. Water pump takes 15 minutes to fill a tank of 400 litres at a height of 10 m. Find:
(a) actual work done by electric motor to full the tank
(b) percentage efficiency of motor. Assume that mass of 1 litre of water = 1 kg). [Ans: (a) 671400 J (b) 11.6 %]
Ek horse power ki electric motor pani ka pump chalati hai. Pump 10 m unchai par 400 litre ki tanki 15 minute mein bharta hai. (a) motor ka asal kaam, (b) motor ki percentage efficiency nikalein (1 litre pani = 1 kg).
blocks.explanation:
Given: P = 1 hp = 746 W; t = 15 min = 900 s; m = 400 litre = 400 kg; h = 10 m
(a) Motor ka asal kaam (di gayi energy):
W_in = Pt = 746 W × 900 s
W_in = 671 400 J
(b) Kaam ka output (pani uthana):
W_out = mgh = 400 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² × 10 m = 39 200 J
Efficiency = (W_out ÷ W_in) × 100%
= (39 200 J ÷ 671 400 J) × 100%
= 5.84 %

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab part (b) mein 11.6 % likhti hai. Diye gaye data se kaam ka output mgh = 400 × 9.8 × 10 = 39 200 J aur input 671 400 J hai, is liye efficiency 5.84 % hai. (11.6 % is ka double hai; is ke liye 800 litre ya 20 m unchai chahiye.) Part (a) ka 671 400 J sahi hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: 1 horse power = 746 W; yeh value is chapter mein nahi di gayi, aam taur par yahi li jati hai. Efficiency = kaam ka output ÷ di gayi energy × 100%.

blocks.prompt:
4.8 A passenger just arrived at the airport and dragging his suitcase to luggage check in desk. He pulls strap with a force of 200 N at an angle of 45° to the floor to displace it 50 m to the desk. Determine the value of work done by him on the suitcase. (Ans: 7 kJ)
Airport par musafir apna suitcase check-in desk tak ghaseet raha hai. Woh strap ko farsh se 45° par 200 N force se kheench kar 50 m le jata hai. Us ka suitcase par kaam nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: F = 200 N; θ = 45°; d = 50 m
Required: kaam W = ?
W = Fd cos θ
W = 200 N × 50 m × cos 45°
W = 10 000 × 0.707 J
W = 7071 J ≈ 7 kJ

blocks.prompt:
4.9 A body of mass 0.5 kg travels in a straight line with velocity v = ay^(3/2), where a = 5 m s⁻². Find the work done by the net force when it travels during the displacement from y = 0 to 5 m. (Ans: 781.25 J)
0.5 kg ka jism seedhi line mein velocity v = ay^(3/2) se chalta hai, jahan a = 5. y = 0 se 5 m tak net force ka kaam nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 0.5 kg; v = ay^(3/2), a = 5 (SI units); y = 0 se 5 m
Required: net force ka kaam W = ?
y = 0 par: v_i = 5 × 0 = 0
y = 5 m par: v_f = 5 × 5^(3/2) = 5 × 11.18 = 55.9 m s⁻¹, to v_f² = 25 × 5³ = 3125 m² s⁻²
Work-energy theorem se: W = ½mv_f² − ½mv_i²
W = ½ × 0.5 kg × 3125 m² s⁻² − 0
W = 781.25 J

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: y ki power halki chhapi hai; isay 3/2 parha gaya hai, jis se kitab ka jawab 781.25 J aata hai. a ka chhapa unit (m s⁻²) v = ay^(3/2) mein theek nahi baithta: v m s⁻¹ aur y m mein ho to a ka unit m^(−1/2) s⁻¹ hona chahiye. Hal mein a = 5 (SI units) liya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
4.10 A 200 g apple is lifted to 10 m and then dropped. What is its velocity when it hits the ground? Assume that 75% of work done in lifting the apple is transferred to K.E. by the time it hits the ground. (Ans: 12.1 m s⁻¹)
200 g ka seb 10 m tak utha kar giraya jata hai. Uthane ke kaam ka 75% ground tak K.E. ban jata hai. Ground se takrate waqt us ki velocity kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Given: m = 200 g = 0.2 kg; h = 10 m; kaam ka 75% K.E. banta hai
Required: v = ?
Uthane ka kaam = mgh = 0.2 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² × 10 m = 19.6 J
Ground par K.E. = 19.6 J ka 75% = 0.75 × 19.6 = 14.7 J
½mv² = 14.7 J
v² = 2 × 14.7 J ÷ 0.2 kg = 147 m² s⁻²
v = 12.1 m s⁻¹
